Question 15
?

An arithmetic series has a2=5 and a9=19, where a2 and a9 are the second and ninth terms of the series, respectively. What is the sum of the first 12 terms of the series, expressed using sigma notation?

a
∑n=112(2n+1)
b
∑n=112(2n+3)
c
∑n=1125n
d
∑n=112(5n+19)
e
∑n=112(2n−1)
Don't Know
